headline: Portfolio Sync Complete (Advisor Analysis Unavailable)
macro_summary: Primary advisory analysis was unavailable, so the system produced a conservative portfolio-manager fallback based on current allocation and the latest synced holdings.

portfolio_overlay.thesis: Maintain core exposure, preserve liquidity, and wait for higher-conviction signals before changing risk materially.
portfolio_overlay.rebalancing_watch: Reassess if a single risk asset becomes dominant or macro data materially shifts rates expectations.

macro_themes.implication: Avoid chasing duration-sensitive growth until policy and yields stabilize.
Keep single-name risk sized so one earnings cycle cannot define portfolio outcomes.

suggestions.rationale: Default to capital preservation when the primary advisory layer is unavailable.
suggestions.thesis: The synced portfolio should remain steady until higher-confidence evidence is available.
suggestions.catalyst: Wait for fresh macro releases, earnings, or validated company-specific developments.
suggestions.risk: Reacting without verified context can degrade entry quality and increase churn.

risks: Advisory service timeout or schema validation failure.
